The general objective of this tender is to build a strong and engaged Natura 2000 community of stakeholders and citizens that supports EU policy implementation and enhances the visibility of the Commission’s actions on nature conservation, in particular:
a)	Establish and manage an online EU Nature Platform: a user-friendly platform to support authorities and stakeholders in implementing EU nature legislation, foster interaction and community building, and provide access to reference documents, best practices, success stories, news, and relevant activities at EU, national and regional level.
b)	Enhance Natura 2000 communication activities: increase awareness of the network and related EU policy objectives among the general public, improve recognition of the Natura 2000 logo, and establish a positive connection with EU nature protection efforts.

normalized.title: Supply of Esri Software Licenses for the SLIM Project
normalized.description: The subject of this public contract is the delivery of ArcGIS platform software licenses to support Geographic Information Systems (GIS) within the SLIM project. The licenses will be used for advanced spatial data processing, specifically in the fields of satellite analysis and environmental monitoring at the National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) in Lusaka. The subject of the contract is the delivery of a comprehensive geospatial software package consisting of perpetual licenses and extended maintenance. The delivery is divided into core enterprise infrastructure and desktop analytical tools. The contract includes software maintenance and technical support, consisting of all manufacturer-offered patches, upgrades, and support necessary for the deployment and continued proper functioning of the licensed software. The maintenance period will be provided for a total of twenty-four (24) months, consisting of twelve (12) months of standard maintenance included in the initial license purchase and twelve (12) months of additional extended maintenance. Throughout the duration of the contract, the supplier shall provide system support for Esri products in accordance with the manufacturer's current Product Life Cycle Support Policy. The subject of the contract is further detailed in Annex No. 1 – List of Supplied Items and in Annex No. 3 Draft Contract. Procedure type: Přímé zadání
